title: penstemon glaber f. cyananthus
intro: Penstemon glaber f. cyananthus, commonly known as the Blue-Eyed Grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. It is native to the southwestern United States and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as soothing skin irritations, calming digestive issues, and supporting respiratory health. Bioactive constituents of Penstemon glaber f. cyananthus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
